high_level_description: This image is a close-up photograph of a Galapagos tortoise named Gramma, who was the oldest resident of the San Diego Zoo. The tortoise is shown eating a piece of green leafy vegetable, possibly lettuce or cabbage, which it is chewing with its mouth open. The tortoise's head is prominent in the frame, showcasing its large, wrinkled skin and distinctive facial features, including its eyes and nose. The background appears to be an outdoor enclosure at the zoo, with some blurred structures and natural elements like dirt and vegetation visible.
